components.featured_app_main: Full-width horizontal card, 120-140px height, rounded-[20px], soft yellow glow shadow. Pinned at top.
components.featured_app_secondary: Two-column grid for app #2 and #3, compact cards.
components.app_list_card: Compact horizontal list, height 120-140px. Icon 48-56px top-left, Title max 2 lines, Rating top-right. Verified badge included.
components.download_button: Premium Yellow (#FFC107) background, rounded-full, soft glow, ripple animation, transform scale down on click.
components.navigation: Sticky top glassmorphism header with logo and admin login link. Bottom padding on body to ensure content visibility.

grids.main_layout: max-w-[430px] mx-auto w-full min-h-screen bg-[#F8F9FA] shadow-2xl overflow-hidden relative

motion.fade_up: initial opacity-0 translate-y-4, animate to opacity-100 translate-y-0
motion.ripple: relative overflow-hidden after:absolute after:inset-0 after:bg-white/20 after:opacity-0 active:after:opacity-100 after:transition-opacity

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over yellow button uses #111111 for high contrast.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first UI centered in the viewport for desktop (max-width 430px), resembling a native Android app.
The body background should be neutral (like #e5e5e5) and the app container itself should be #F8F9FA, centered with shadow-2xl.
Use framer-motion for 60FPS hardware-accelerated list animations (fade up on scroll, translate, and opacity only).
App cards MUST have a height around 120-140px, full-width, clean white bg (#FFFFFF), 18-22px border radius, thin #E5E7EB border, and a soft shadow.
Include an Admin Panel (JWT auth) to manage APKs and feature apps, with file upload capability. Use standard .js files (not .tsx).
Use Lucide-react icons for verified badges (Success Green #22C55E) and ratings (Yellow #FFC107).
Implement Shimmer skeleton loaders for the initial data fetch. Do not leave the screen blank on load.
Telegram CTA should use #229ED9. Feature it visibly.
Download buttons must have ripple effects, active scale-down, and a soft yellow glow (#FFC107).
Do NOT use HTML input date or select, use Shadcn. Do not center-align the app container text (no .App { text-align: center }).
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use transparent backgrounds in headers if content scrolls under them; use backdrop-blur.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
Do not apply universal transition (transition: all). Target specific properties.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Add micro-animations to all interactive elements.
Use generous spacing (p-4 to p-6 inside cards).
Ensure contrast rules are met. High contrast on text.
